attchmntText: Copy of Newspaper Publications are being submitted regarding the Unaudited Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: M. K. Proteins Limited submitted newspaper publications for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company enclosed copies of publications from the Financial Express English Edition and Jansatta Hindi Edition. These publications contain the Unaudited Financial Results for the specified period. The submission was made pursuant to Regulation 47 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015. The notice was addressed to the Manager of Listing Compliance at Bombay Stock Exchange Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The BSE scrip code is 543919. The NSE symbol is MKPL. The document was signed by Neha Aggarwal, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The date of the letter is 14.11.2026.

attchmntText: M K Proteins Limited has submitted to the Exchange, Un-Audited Standalone Financial Results of the Company for the Quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, together with a Statement of Cash Flow, Statement of Assets and Liabilities for the same period
voiceSummary: M. K. Proteins Limited approved its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 13, 2026. The company reported a profit before tax of 301.28 lakhs for the half year. Revenue from operations stood at 11516.12 lakhs. Net profit for the period was 225.20 lakhs. Earnings per share were 0.06. The statutory auditors issued a limited review report with no material misstatements noted. Total assets as of September 30, 2026, were 8345.78 lakhs. Equity stood at 7855.22 lakhs. The results are placed for regulatory record.
